archetype: Warm Clinical & Precision Surgical Editorial (Archetype 1 + High Precision Data Mode B)
vibe: Warm alabaster and deep Nordic pine, surgical-grade data precision, humane and empathetic patient care, zero generic purple AI-slop gradients

theme_strategy.rationale: Medical and clinical EMR systems demand high optical legibility under hospital ambient lighting. Light warm-alabaster mode is optimal for clinical charting, prescription reviews, and billing audits. A dedicated deep dark console toggle is available for nocturnal shifts.

typography.anti_default_rule: BANNED: Inter, Roboto, Open Sans for headings. NO generic AI slop.

1_executive_dashboard.description: Command center with bed occupancy, daily patient throughput, urgent lab alerts, active prescriptions, and billing collections

2_patient_emr_management.description: Comprehensive Electronic Medical Record view with medical history, allergies, vitals timeline, encounter notes, and SOAP formatting
components: Patient Profile Banner with Blood Type & Critical Flags

3_appointment_scheduling.description: Multi-provider calendar view (Day, Week, Month) with doctor filter, room selector, and appointment status flow (Scheduled, Checked-In, In-Consultation, Completed)
components: Quick-Book Appointment Dialog with time slots

4_prescriptions_and_medications.description: Electronic prescription authoring with dosage calculators, frequency intervals, drug-interaction allergy cross-checks, and auto-dispatch to pharmacy

5_pharmacy_inventory.description: Stock levels, batch expiry tracking, low-stock threshold alerts, and direct dispensing interface

6_laboratory_and_diagnostics.description: Order diagnostic panels (CBC, Lipid, Metabolic, Biopsy), upload/record test values, reference range visual flags (Normal vs High/Low)
components: Quantitative Value Range Indicator with High/Low Flag

7_ai_clinical_assistant.description: HIPAA-conscious AI clinical copilot for ICD-10 code suggestion, drug interaction checks, differential diagnosis ideas, and SOAP note synthesis

8_billing_and_insurance.description: Claims processing, Superbills, Invoice generation, Stripe checkout modal integration, and payment receipt logs
components: Stripe Checkout Simulator / Payment Gateway Trigger

9_staff_and_rbac.description: Hospital staff directory with license numbers, assigned departments, on-call schedules, and role permission matrices

accessibility_and_contrast.text_contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for standard body text, 3:1 for large display headers
accessibility_and_contrast.focus_states: High-contrast ring with ring-[#0F3E2E] dark:ring-emerald-400 and ring-offset-2
accessibility_and_contrast.reduced_motion: All motion transitions respect prefers-reduced-motion media query

testing_attributes.requirement: EVERY interactive element and primary data container MUST carry a role-based kebab-case data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Read this guidelines file carefully. DO NOT use generic purple gradients or default standard Inter headings.
2. Implement a unified multi-tenant hospital/clinic operating system with instant tenant switcher in header/sidebar.
3. Use the defined color tokens: Nordic Pine (#0F3E2E) as primary anchor, Warm Alabaster (#FBF9F5) as base canvas, and warm borders (#E5E0D8).
4. Ensure all tab switches (Patients, Appointments, Prescriptions, Pharmacy, Lab, Staff, AI Assistant, Billing) render realistic and complete interactive clinical flows.

5. Populate rich, authentic clinical data: realistic blood pressure readings, glucose levels, medication dosages (e.g., Atorvastatin 20mg, Amoxicillin 500mg, Metformin 850mg), ICD-10 diagnostic codes, and lab panels.
6. Include the AI Clinical Assistant with interactive prompt chips and diagnostic synthesis.
7. Attach data-testid to all buttons, tabs, inputs, modals, and status badges so end-to-end tests can verify seamlessly.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_ai_slop: Never apply centered body layouts, uniform boring cards, or glowing neon gradients. Use organic structure, crisp borders, and surgical typography.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.toasts: Use Sonner for toasts (sonner package installed).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.icons: Use lucide-react with specific medical icons (Stethoscope, Activity, Pill, FlaskConical, Calendar, FileText, Bot, DollarSign, ShieldCheck, Building2).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Generous clinical spacing: p-6 to p-8 for major sections, compact p-3 for dense data grids.
